title: Lizard Palms | KEY.co
description_expanded: Step outside and discover a private backyard oasis built for relaxation and connection. A wraparound porch leads to the brand-new saltwater pool featuring a tanning shelf, sunken seating, and plenty of room to lounge under the palms. The fully fenced yard offers privacy and space to entertain, complete with a BBQ grill and al fresco dining area. Gulf views from the upstairs balcony add an extra touch of serenity, especially from the master suite, where a spa-like ensuite and private sitting area offer a luxurious escape. Whether soaking up the sun, enjoying morning coffee with a view, or hosting sunset dinners poolside, Lizard Palms is a picture-perfect home for your next 30A vacation. Lizard Palms is a charming, coastal retreat tucked away in the heart of Dune Allen Beach, just a short stroll from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf. With five bedrooms and space for up to sixteen guests, this spacious home blends classic Southern charm with modern luxury. Soaring ceilings, curated decor, and rich hardwood floors create an airy, welcoming atmosphere, while large windows invite natural light throughout the open living space. The recently updated kitchen, complete with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas—perfect for gathering with family or friends after a day at the beach.
